title: Correct signed-frame lengths in link draft examples
description: Correctness review found spec/drafts/draft-lichen-link-01.md examples 6.1 and 6.2 added mandatory SIID fields/flags without adding their 8 bytes to LENGTH. Broadcast DIO with 22-byte PLD has body 1+1+2+8+22+48=82 (0x52), total 83, not 0x4A/75. Extended unicast with 1-byte PLD has body 1+1+2+8 DST+8 SIID+1+48=69 (0x45), not 0x3D. Correct arithmetic and add regression checks for example field sums so future wire-field additions cannot leave lengths stale.
